name: Nagaland
tagline: Experience the Vibrant Tribes of North East India

topAttractions.name: Dzukou Valley
topAttractions.description: A scenic valley nestled in the Patkai Hills, known for its stunning natural beauty and trekking opportunities.

topAttractions.name: Kohima War Cemetery
topAttractions.description: A historic cemetery that commemorates the soldiers who lost their lives during World War II's Battle of Kohima.

topAttractions.name: Mokokchung
topAttractions.description: The 'Mokokchung Heritage Village' showcases the traditional Ao Naga culture and architecture.

bestTimeToVisit: October to May, when the weather is mild and pleasant, making it ideal for trekking and sightseeing.
signatureFood: Naga Cuisine's signature dish, 'Aloo Pitika' (Mashed Potato with Smoked Pork)
culturalFact: Nagaland is home to the Angami Naga's traditional 'Daos' (wooden swords), which are intricately carved and considered a symbol of the tribe's rich cultural heritage.

hiddenGem.name: Phek District's 'Pulongduen Lake'
hiddenGem.description: A serene and picturesque lake surrounded by lush greenery, perfect for a peaceful getaway.

relatedFestival: The Hornbill Festival, a 10-day celebration of Naga culture, music, and traditions, held annually in December.
passportTieIn: If you have stamps from the Hornbill Festival or have a wishlist item for the 'Dzukou Valley Trek', now's the time to plan your Nagaland trip!
